placement_note: istop (default, Johannes 15:02): WCS origin = panel front-left corner at stock top; front = I-stop / logo side = sim -Y; panel front edge (WCS ymin) on the I-stop face (rail scale M = stops_M.S1_IJ_face -> sim Y), panel X centred on sim 0 (field-1 rails are centred there by sim_x0; real X position vs the X stop unknown). setup = as the bath setups today: stock bottom-centre at the sim origin.
rot0_means: top plate shifted toward higher rail-scale M (back / park side); rot 180 = toward the front (I stop)
through_note: through cut = tool tip below the panel bottom; pod top plates keep through_clearance from that tool envelope (disc R + through_clearance); other cuts reaching within 'clearance' of the pod-top plane keep R + clearance
size_note: target pods = clamp(ceil(panel area / area_per_pod_m2), min_pods, max_pods); the fewest pods >= target that meet the support rules win
support_note: support polygon = convex hull of all pod top plates; must cover >= hull_min_fraction of the panel area and span >= span_min_fraction of the panel extent in X and in Y
rank_note: rank: fewest pods, fewest rails, support hull in 5% bins, then total sealed top-plate area (bigger pods hold better), then hull
